roles.summary: Multi-tenant LLM and RAG inference platform for 20+ enterprise deployments.
details: Architected a multi-tenant LLM and RAG inference platform supporting 1M+ daily requests, separating retrieval, orchestration, and model-serving services on Kubernetes to maintain 99.9% uptime

Designed LangGraph-based AI orchestration workflows integrating document analysis, retrieval, LLM inference, and response verification, with automated validation gates, retry mechanisms, and fault isolation
Spearheaded the migration of 12 legacy ML workloads to AWS with Docker and Terraform, reducing infrastructure costs by 35% and deployment cycles from 10 days to 2 days
Orchestrated a cross-functional team of 6 engineers and 3 product owners to deliver a document-intelligence agent in 10 weeks
Instituted automated model evaluation and drift monitoring with MLflow, Prometheus, and Grafana in CI/CD, detecting model regressions 4x faster and reducing production incidents by 40%

Hardened embedding and vector-search infrastructure handling 50M+ documents through index sharding, response caching, and load-tested failover, keeping p95 latency below 300 ms under 3x normal traffic
Mentored 4 junior engineers, cutting their time to first production release from 8 weeks to 5

roles.summary: Semantic ranking, retrieval quality and RAG for enterprise search.
details: Optimized transformer-based semantic ranking models using hard-negative mining and embedding fine-tuning, improving offline top-3 relevance by 18% on NDCG and online click-through rates by 9%
Streamlined model development with reusable Apache Airflow pipelines and standardized feature management, reducing training and evaluation turnaround from 5 days to 1.5 days
Investigated retrieval-quality regressions across 30+ enterprise data connectors, tracing index staleness and tokenization inconsistencies and restoring measured answer accuracy to 94%
Accelerated search inference through INT8 quantization, request batching, and embedding caching, reducing p95 query latency by 40%, from 820 ms to 490 ms
Tuned RAG retrieval and generation across a 1,500-question evaluation benchmark, reducing hallucinated responses by 27%

roles.summary: Data Scientist (Aug 2021 – Dec 2022), promoted from Associate Data Scientist (Jan – Jul 2021).
details: Constructed a retail demand-forecasting model with XGBoost and Prophet ensembles, engineering 60+ predictive features and reducing MAPE from 18% to 14%
Integrated an NLP-based service ticket classifier using FastAPI and Docker on Azure, automating 70% of ticket routing and saving about 1,200 agent hours quarterly
Automated weekly operational reporting for 5 business units with Python, SQL, and Airflow, saving 25 analyst hours per week
Formulated a randomized experimentation framework supporting a 6% improvement in retention across 40K customers
Prototyped a hybrid recommendation system that lifted click-through rates by 12% in A/B testing
Trained Random Forest and XGBoost churn models reaching an AUC of 0.86, and validated a BERT document classifier at 91% F1 on 10K records
